findings.current: Despite Jin Mukyung’s icy words, Jin Wikyung seemed not to hear a thing. Still deeply moved, he spread both arms wide.
findings.defect: The translation omits that Jin Mukyung continued speaking coldly, treating the preceding quoted remark as the entirety of his response.
findings.rationale: 싸늘한 말이 이어졌지만 explicitly says the cold remarks continued while Jin Wikyung ignored them.
findings.replacement: Jin Mukyung continued speaking in an icy tone, but Jin Wikyung seemed not to hear a thing. Still deeply moved, he spread both arms wide.

findings.defect: The Quest title retains square brackets inside a System window, contrary to the binding System UI convention.
findings.rationale: The editorial rules require System notices and UI terms to appear without square brackets because the blockquote window and System heading already identify the interface.

findings.current: *I thought the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s main force had been wiped out at Eight Spring Gorge too.*
findings.defect: The translation changes the specifically identified leading masters into the broader and less precise “main force.”
findings.rationale: 주력 고수들 refers to the sect’s principal masters, with 고수 bindingly rendered as “master”; 전멸 also explicitly indicates that all of them were wiped out.
findings.replacement: *I thought the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s leading masters had all been wiped out at Eight Spring Gorge too.*

findings.defect: The line prematurely states that Taekyung has forgotten the name, duplicating the conclusion Jin Wikyung reaches only after Taekyung’s response.
findings.rationale: 처음 듣는 이름이더냐 asks whether the name is unfamiliar. Jin Wikyung does not explicitly conclude that Taekyung has forgotten until the subsequent 역시 기억 못 하는구나.
findings.replacement: “Is this the first time you’ve heard the name?”

findings.current: Everything moved at lightning speed. It had been only two hours since Jin Wikyung saw us off and we climbed into the four-horse carriage.
findings.defect: The source’s traditional time unit is converted into modern hours despite the binding glossary requiring “shichen.”
findings.rationale: 한 시진 is exactly one shichen; two hours is only its approximate modern duration and loses the source-specific unit.
findings.replacement: Everything moved at lightning speed. It had been only one shichen since Jin Wikyung saw us off and we climbed into the four-horse carriage.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin clowning around was nothing new; when it came to dealing with that, I already had a full sixty-year cycle of internal energy.
findings.defect: The punchline replaces the binding cultural term “jiazi” with its explanatory duration.
findings.rationale: 일 갑자 means one jiazi, and the exact glossary requires that term. Retaining it also preserves the joke’s mock–martial arts formulation rather than explaining the unit inside the punchline.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin clowning around was nothing new; when it came to dealing with that, I already had a full jiazi of internal energy.

summary: Faithful overall, with six minor defects involving an omitted continuing action, System-title formatting, one imprecise subject, premature disclosure of a memory issue, and two binding cultural terms.
